incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency exceeded threshold for service=runtime-gateway env=prod region=us-west. Current p99=2.1s (SLO=1.0s). PagerDuty triggered: PD-INC-4721. Link: https://alerts.internal/PD-INC-4721

oncall-sara: acked in PD — I'm on it, joining bridge. First check: any recent deploys?

naresh: saw a tiny canary rolled at 16:45 UTC, but it's CPU-bound inference variant. Could be related.

maria: routing shows increased tail for seq_len>512 requests from customer A. KV cache miss rate jumped ~8x.

jordan: autoscaler logs show scale-up lag in us-west pool — some nodes didn't register after spin up (cloud quota errors).

oncall-sara: copy. steps: 1) pause new canary rollouts 2) force-fallback to v1 model for production traffic 3) warm KV cache for high traffic keys 4) open bridge if PD not enough.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-4721 acknowledged by oncall-sara. Escalation policy: not yet escalated.

naresh: pausing rollout now (deploy-service rollback --id canary-2026-03-17). Doing a quick `kubectl rollout undo` on canary namespace.

maria: routing change applied: route weight v2 -> 0%, v1 -> 100% for service runtime-gateway (applied via traffic-controller).

jordan: forced resize on us-west pool: submitted manual scale request to +6 GPUs. Some quota fails, retrying with smaller batches.

oncall-sara: attempting warmup for top-20 hotkeys: running cache-warm script on edge nodes. Command: 
```
./tools/warm_kv_cache --region us-west --keys-file /tmp/hotkeys.txt
```

maria: hotkey warmup in progress. Miss rate for those keys falling, latency improving on a subset.

naresh: investigating the node registration errors with infra team (cc @infra). Short-term: divert heavy customers to dedicated fallback pool in another region (us-east) with lower latency but higher cost.

oncall-sara: spun up failover routing for customer A -> us-east-dedicated. Applied circuit-breaker to limit concurrent requests to 50 for affected tenant to reduce queuing.

jordan: telemetry: p99 dropped from 2.1s -> 1.3s after fallback and warmup. Still above SLO but trending down. Keep monitoring.

maria: customer-facing impact: estimated 10-15% of requests experienced degraded latency during 16:44-16:58 UTC. No error-rate increase. Preparing short internal blurb for CS.

oncall-sara: creating incident bridge: https://meet.internal/bridge/PD-4721, invite sent. Adding runbook link: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/latency-slo-burn

pagerduty-bot: Note: PD escalation if no progress in 15m. Next escalation to L2 oncall: @naresh.

naresh: infra confirms transient quota API flakiness; nodes eventually registered after second retry. They've requested follow-up with cloud provider.

jordan: once nodes registered, autoscaler resumed normal behavior. We'll keep dedicated fallback for 30m then re-evaluate.

maria: perf graphs: p95 back to 0.85s, p99 ~1.05s. Still close to threshold; will monitor for steady 15m window before closing.

oncall-sara: agreed. Action items: 
- [x] rollback canary
- [x] warm KV cache
- [x] route heavy tenant -> dedicated pool
- [x] scale up nodes (partial success)
- [ ] follow-up with cloud provider (naresh)
- [ ] post-incident customer note draft (maria/jordan)

maria: drafting CS note now. Short summary + mitigation + ETA for follow-up.

naresh: filing follow-up ticket with cloud provider: CLOUD-10293. Will attach logs and request quota stability analysis.

oncall-sara: preparing handoff to night oncall in 25m. If metrics stay stable, we'll keep the dedicated pool for the window then drain traffic back to us-west.

jordan: quick logs excerpt: 
```
2026-03-17T16:46:12Z WARN kv-cache miss key=user:acct:12345 seq_len=1024
2026-03-17T16:46:13Z ERROR node-register failed quota-error code=429 cloudapi
```

maria: adding that excerpt to the incident timeline.

oncall-sara: final update before handoff: p99 steady at 0.98s for last 5m, no new PD pages. Handoff to @naresh who will monitor overnight. Creating rotation note in incident doc. :thumbsup:

naresh: ack handoff. I'll keep watch and escalate if it creeps. Leaving incident open for follow-up actions.

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-4721 status: acknowledged -> in_progress. Severity: Sev3. Link: https://incidents.internal/PD-4721
